title: node
description: A single bounding volume hierarchy node

resourceId.description: Index of the first child of this node. The resourceID must be used to query node resources, like geometry buffer (XYZ) /nodes//geometry/0 and attribute buffers. One buffer can have one attribute. Available attributes are declared in the SceneLayer document. /nodes//attributes/.

firstChild.description: Index of the first child of this node.

childCount.description: Number of children for this node. Value is 0 if node is a leaf node.

vertexCount.description: Number of points for this node.

obb.description: Oriented bounding boxes (OBB) are the only supported bounding volumes.

lodThreshold.description: This metric may be used as a threshold to split a parent node into its children. See [layer.store.index.lodSelectionMetricType](index.pcsl.md)
